{d) Disconnect the rear axle carrier from the lower suspen-

7. DISCONNECT REAR SHOCK ABSORBER
Remove the bolt and nut and disconnect the rear shock absorb­
er.
Torque: 140 N-m (1,428 kgf.cm, 103 ft•lbf)
NOTICE:
Do not turn the nut.
HINT:
At the time of installation, after stabilizing the suspension,
torque the bolt.
8. REMOVE LOWER SUSPENSION ARM
(a) Remove the bolt and nut on the rear side of lower suspen­
sion arm.
Torque: 74 N.m (755 kgf.cm, 55 ft•lbf)
HINT:
At the Hrne of installation, after stabilizing the suspension,
torque the nut.
(b) Remove the front side 3 bolts and lower suspension arm.
9. REMOVE SUSPENSION ARM BRACKET
Remove the nut, suspension arm bracket and stopper.
Torque: 110 N.m (1,122 kgf.cm, 81 ft•lbf)
HINT:
At the lime of installation. after stabilizing the suspension,
torque the nut.
